speaker: Leonard
text: Leonard, why haven't I heard a thing about this woman who lives across the hall and comes into your apartment in the morning in her underwear? Um, she's heard about you because we're, you know, involved, and and you haven't heard about her because I never slept with her, I swear.

speaker: Sheldon
text: In Leonard's defense, it wasn't for lack of trying. You're welcome, Leonard.

speaker: Leonard
text: Look, I'm just saying, um, Penny is one of our many neighbors, you know, in our building. Neighbors come and go. It's very casual, no dress code. In fact, some mornings I'll just mosey down to the third floor in my pajamas and have cereal with Mrs. Vartabedian.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Really? I've never once been invited to have cereal with Mrs. Vartabedian.

speaker: Leonard
text: She doesn't like you. Well, you have a gallbladder to remove, and I have to get in the shower, and Penny has clothes to put on, so.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, it was very nice meeting you. Nice to finally meet you, too. And I'll see you the next time. Bye.
